highlighted_projects.description: Developed a Python-based photo editing tool with advanced colour replacement capabilities. Manipulated colour space data using NumPy and SciPy matrix transformations to isolate and replace specific colour ranges within images. Integrated a fuzzy selection feature with adjustable sensitivity thresholds for precise colour targeting. Implemented lossless upscaling algorithms based on mathematical interpolation techniques to preserve image fidelity. Designed an intuitive PySimpleGUI interface to enhance accessibility for non-technical users.
highlighted_projects.name: Image Filter and Effects App

highlighted_projects.description: Led a team of 3 developers in a high-pressure hackathon environment, coordinating task delegation and sprint planning to deliver a Granite AI-powered staffing optimization tool for healthcare settings. Engineered a robust Python data pipeline to validate and standardize input data, ensuring consistency across the system. Implemented advanced prompt engineering techniques to fine-tune Granite AI responses, achieving a 25%+ reduction in average simulated patient wait times.
highlighted_projects.name: Hospital Staffing Level AI Prediction tool

jarvis_projects.description: Developed a metrics collection and storage system for Linux cluster monitoring. Leveraged Bash scripts (lscpu, vmstat) to extract, process, and store hardware and usage metrics. Deployed a Dockerized PostgreSQL database for persistent data storage. Streamlined deployment workflows through automated database provisioning and management scripts, reducing setup time. Scheduled automated data collection using Crontab.
jarvis_projects.name: Cluster Monitor

jarvis_projects.description: Cloned the Linux grep utility in Java that accepts three command-line arguments (searchDirectory, regexPattern, and outputFile) to recursively search through directories and log matching lines. The project leverages Java Lambdas, Streams, and standard Logging frameworks, with a robust test suite built via JUnit and dependency management handled by Maven. For seamless deployment, the application was Dockerized and published to Docker Hub.
jarvis_projects.name: Java Grep App

jarvis_projects.description: Ingested two years of anonymous retail data into a dockerized PostgreSQL database, then cleaned and transformed the dataset using Python, NumPy, and Pandas to derive impactful business insights. Based on these findings, I created and delivered a presentation for stakeholders that highlighted a major untapped 'non-home' market and outlined strategic next steps to capitalize on the opportunity
jarvis_projects.name: Python analytics project

summary: I am a data engineer graduating from Ontario Tech University with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (Co-op). Previously, I worked at Code Ninjas as a black-box tester, where I collaborated with a development team to create 100+ test cases and identify and resolve 50+ bugs in an in-house web application. What draws me to data engineering is my passion for problem-solving, designing pipelines and transforming messy datasets into clean, structured information feels like solving an intricate puzzle, and the satisfaction when everything clicks into place is unmatched.
